case_name: CORRECTED (Case Correction Gate): evidenced developer-name conflict (Redrow Homes / Redrow NW) - NOT established same-subject control
commercial_scenario: CORRECTED (2026-09-15): this case's original name/premise was wrong. The frozen ownership_control_posture is EVIDENCED_CONFLICT_POTENTIALLY_BLOCKING, not ESTABLISHED_SAME_SUBJECT_CONTROL - a 'Redrow Homes' vs. 'Redrow NW' name-variant conflict trips the conflict branch of compute_ownership_control_posture() before the established-control branch is ever reached. A read-only search across the entire current 389-candidate universe found ZERO opportunities with ownership_control_posture==ESTABLISHED_SAME_SUBJECT_CONTROL (see Case Correction Gate Section 12/P) - no real seed for that reasoning capability currently exists. This case is retained under its TRUE purpose: does the model correctly treat a recorded developer-name conflict as a resolvable, phase-scoped verification question (confirm the developer's actual identity) rather than either a whole-allocation control fact or a reason to walk away, and without either overreacting or silently ignoring the recorded conflict.

commercial_rationale: PRODUCT OWNER SETTLED DECISION (Case Correction Gate Section 13): VERIFY only, not established control. A recorded developer-name conflict on an otherwise strong-fit, in-target-range, permission-granted phase is exactly the material+resolvable+blocking shape VERIFY exists for: confirm which entity (Redrow Homes vs. Redrow NW - plausibly the same legal entity under two source spellings) actually holds the relevant role, before deciding whether/how to proceed. Do NOT treat this as established control of anything, whole-allocation or otherwise - the posture is EVIDENCED_CONFLICT_POTENTIALLY_BLOCKING, not ESTABLISHED_SAME_SUBJECT_CONTROL. NOT YET APPROVED.
